statements.impact_statement: No fixed braces release exists. Its only call site in this app is chokidar 3's glob expansion of the watch path, which server/bridge.js disables with disableGlobbing: true, so no input reaches braces.expand(). Mirrors the waiver in osv-scanner.toml.

No fixed sprintf-js release exists; exploitation requires an attacker-controlled format string. 1.0.3 is reached only via argparse from js-yaml 3's CLI, which gray-matter never executes; 1.1.3 is electron-builder build-time logging with fixed format strings and is not packaged. Mirrors the waiver in osv-scanner.toml.
